channel.title: The Lowndes Signal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Lowndes Signal (lowndessignal.com)

item.title: Faith Community Calendar
item.description: Macedonia Missionary Baptist and Hayneville Baptist share upcoming events; see program details and how to submit items to the Lowndes Signal Faith Community Calendar.

item.title: Communities United presents mission addressing persistent poverty
item.description: Communities Unlimited outlines its work to move rural areas of persistent poverty toward sustainable prosperity, highlighting White Hall projects at the Lowndes County Children's Policy Council.

item.title: Extension seeks families for gardening program
item.description: Lowndes County Extension offers free 8-month home vegetable gardening program for families with children, including supplies, classes and nutrition tips.

item.title: Love is all around us
item.description: A minister reflects on Valentine’s Day and what true love really is, contrasting infatuation and sexuality with the biblical model of selfless, patient love in 1 Corinthians 13.

item.title: Knowing Jesus ensures no more 'Lookin' for Love'
item.description: Using "Lookin' for Love" and Urban Cowboy as a backdrop, Pastor Dunford Cole argues that lasting love, happiness and purpose are found by seeking Jesus Christ first.

item.title: Show athletes love: Vote now
item.description: On Valentine's Day, vote hourly to support Lowndes County student-athletes for Athlete of the Week; winners earn treats and advance to April's Athlete of the Year contest.

item.title: Relay for Life moving toward April event
item.description: Lowndes County plans its first post-COVID Relay for Life on April 24 in Hayneville, raising funds for the American Cancer Society and seeking county support for a survivors' banquet.

item.title: A hoped-for Valentine’s gift
item.description: An author recalls her father's simple Valentine’s Week chocolates and urges men to give daily, thoughtful gifts — and God continual praise — as expressions of love.

item.title: A lot of people are upset
item.description: After a sermon mentioning Ronald Reagan’s charitable giving, a pastor reflects on criticism, divine judgment and the call to honor God in every word, deed and dollar.

item.title: Marshae Madison declares bid for District 69 seat
item.description: Educator Marshae Madison launches bid for Alabama House District 69, vowing to bolster schools, jobs, healthcare, infrastructure and public safety ahead of the May 19 vote.
